en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>

regarding three witnesses upon one man with the adultery. So Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Where is the fourth?’ So they said, ‘He is coming just now’. So Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Apply the Penalty (Hadd) upon them, for there is nothing in the Penalties, waiting for a moment’.
